pages.text: The $(d)Redstone Remote$() acts like the $(l:irregular_implements:items/redstone_activator)Redstone Activator$(/l), but can be used from a distance.$(br2)It can have up to 9 stored locations. Sneak right-click it to open its GUI, and insert set $(l:irregular_implements:items/location_filter)Location Filters$(/l). You can place an item in the slot above to give its button an icon.
Right-click while not sneaking to access the location buttons. Click the button to pulse its location for a short duration.
